user.title: Choose the vehicle
user.description: Vehicles found in the FordConnect Query integration.

settings.title: {name}
settings.description: FordConnect Query does not report the battery size or the outside temperature.

data_description.battery_kwh: Usable (net) capacity in kWh, from your vehicle documentation. Used for the energy figures and the range model.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. An outdoor temperature sensor. If empty, the weather entity's temperature is used.
data_description.weather_entity: Used as temperature fallback and for tomorrow's range forecast.

error.temperature_source_required: Choose an outside temperature sensor, a weather entity, or both.

abort.no_vehicles: No vehicle found. Install and set up FordConnect Query first: {url}
abort.already_configured: All vehicles found are already set up.

data.stale_unavailable_h: Alert when the integration is unavailable for
data.stale_no_update_h: Alert when the car has not reported for

data_description.notify_services: For example mobile_app_ followed by your phone name. Leave empty to send no notifications; the event entities still fire.
data_description.dashboard_path: Opened when a notification is tapped, for example /dashboard-ford-ev.
data_description.price_entity: Price per kWh in your currency. Takes precedence over the fixed price.
data_description.price_fixed: Price per kWh, used when no price entity is set. Applies to charging at home.
data_description.public_price_entity: Price per kWh away from home. Takes precedence over the fixed public price.
data_description.public_price_fixed: Price per kWh away from home, used when no public price entity is set. Without a public price, charging away from home costs nothing.
data_description.solar_power_entity: Current solar production. When set, solar power above the house base load covers home charging first. A forecast sensor works as an estimate.
data_description.solar_price_entity: What a solar kWh used for charging is worth to you, for example what exporting it would earn. Takes precedence over the fixed solar price.
data_description.solar_price_fixed: Used when no solar price entity is set. Without either, solar kWh are free.
data_description.base_load_w: Solar power the house uses before the car gets any.
data_description.ac_loss_pct: Energy the meter bills above what the car reports when charging on AC (onboard charger, wallbox, cable).
data_description.dc_loss_pct: Energy the meter bills above what the car reports when charging on DC.
data_description.ice_consumption: Optional. Litres per 100 km of the combustion car to compare with. When set, a sensor shows what driving electric has saved.
data_description.fuel_price_entity: Price per litre in your currency. Takes precedence over the fixed fuel price.
data_description.fuel_price_fixed: Price per litre, used when no fuel price entity is set.

error.temperature_source_required: Choose an outside temperature sensor, a weather entity, or both.

charger_energy_home_week.name: Energy charged at home this week

charger_energy_home_month.name: Energy charged at home this month

reset_range_model.name: Reset range model
reset_range_model.description: Resets the learned range factors and sets the model battery level to the car's. Use it after correcting the battery capacity.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one vehicle is set up.

add_charge.name: Add a past charge
add_charge.description: Counts a charge that happened before the integration could track it, for example before it was installed. It goes into the lifetime totals and into the week and month it belongs to.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one vehicle is set up.

energy_kwh.name: Energy
energy_kwh.description: Energy charged, as the car or its app reports it. Use 0 to record only a cost for a charge already counted.

location.name: Location
location.description: Home is priced at the electricity price, public at the public charging price.

charging_type.name: Charging type
charging_type.description: Chooses the AC or DC losses. Default: AC at home, DC in public.

solar_share.name: Solar share
solar_share.description: Share of the billed energy that came from solar, 0 to 1. Home only.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: The amount actually paid, for example from an invoice. Replaces the calculated cost.

set_period_odometer.name: Set the odometer at the start of a period
set_period_odometer.description: Corrects the distance of the current day, week, month or year when it began before the integration was installed, for example with the odometer when the car was delivered. Only the distance changes: consumption and costs per 100 km stay on the km tracked since installation. Long-term statistics record the difference at the time of the correction.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one vehicle is set up.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: The odometer at the start of the period, or when the car was delivered if that was later. In km, or in miles when Home Assistant uses the US customary unit system, whatever unit an entity is displayed in. At most the odometer now.
